messages:
Theo Martins: Hey team  excited to join Redwood Inference as a PM on Product Analytics — first day here. I'm based in SGP (SGT). Quick asks: who do I poke for API keys, GitHub org access for product-ml, and a short intro to the weekly sync cadence? Also very important: which sticker pack is the new-hire default? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Priya Rao: Welcome Theo!!! :tada: I'll get you added to product-ml repo and the org. API keys are requested via the console (Console -> API Keys -> Request), but ping @Samir for a dev key shortcut if you need one fast. Weekly sync is Thurs 10am PT (we alternate APAC-friendly times).
Samir Gupta: hey Theo  I'm infra buddy for the week. For a quick dev key: DM me your email and project name, I'll create a scoped key with limited quotas. For GitHub, which username?
Theo Martins: thanks Samir  username is themartins. Also can someone confirm SSH setup? I'm on Ubuntu 22.04. I added my pubkey but `ssh git@github.com` prompts `Permission denied (publickey)`. Any quick checks?
Eve Tran: Hi! common issues: confirm key is in ~/.ssh/ and `ssh-add -l` shows the key. Try:
```
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
ssh -T git@github.com
```
If you see `Hi <user>! You've successfully authenticated`, you're good. If not, check `~/.ssh/config` for `IdentitiesOnly yes` blocking agent.
Security Bot: Reminder: do not paste private keys in public channels. Use the secure ticketing flow if you need help: https://infra.redwood/support/ssh.
Theo Martins: ah okay I'll try ssh-add now. Also tiny icebreaker: I collect vintage camera lenses and my guilty pleasure is sour cherry jam. Two truths one lie: I once biked across 3 countries in a week, I'm allergic to cilantro, I can juggle 5 balls. Guess?
Priya Rao: wow lenses!! I'm guessing the cilantro allergy is the lie (seems plausible but sneaky).
Samir Gupta: bike one week seems intense  I'm betting on juggling being the lie. Either way welcome. I'll DM you about a 30m onboarding sync today to walk through repos and keys.
MDM Bot: Device enrollment check: if onboarding from laptop, ensure MDM profile installed. Visit CompanyPortal -> Enroll. If blocked, file a ticket and attach serial.
Theo Martins: thanks all  did ssh-add and `ssh -T` worked. Submitted a GitHub access request and pinged Samir for the dev key. Appreciate the warm welcome  looking forward to the sync and stickers (I'd like the retro camera sticker pack if available).
